LIST1.TITLE: When Perpendicular Parking (Parking in a Garage)

ITEM.PTXT: The "estimated course lines" indicate the steering angle when reversing; by reversing while operating the steering wheel so that the estimated course lines match the lines of the parking space, the vehicle can be guided into the parking space.

The "vehicle width extension lines" serve as a guide when parking straight within a space; by judging the relationship (intersecting → parallel) between the parking space lines and the vehicle width extension lines, it can be confirmed that the vehicle is facing straight into the space.

When parallel parking guide mode is selected, in addition to the screen display, guidance on the vehicle stop positions and steering operation timing is given at each point in the parallel parking process. Some of these are shown below.

LIST1.TITLE: Stop Position Guidance Before Steering Operation

ITEM.PTXT: After the vehicle is stopped at the initial position, the voice guidance "Back up until the green vertical line aligns with the rear of the adjacent vehicle, then stop. " is output. By reversing until the green vertical line aligns with the rear end of the adjacent vehicle according to the voice guidance, the vehicle can be stopped at the appropriate position before turning the steering wheel.

When the vehicle reverses with the green vertical line aligned with the rear end of the adjacent vehicle, a "green frame linked to steering operation" is displayed on the screen together with the voice guidance "While stopped, turn the steering wheel to align the green frame with the parking space. " is output. By turning the steering wheel according to the voice guidance and aligning the green frame with the desired parking position, the appropriate steering angle can be set.

When the vehicle is backed up following the voice guidance, a "green curve" is displayed; when the vehicle is backed up further until the "green curve" aligns with the edge point where the driver wants to park, the voice guidance says "When the green line aligns with the position you want to pull over to, stop and turn the steering wheel fully to the right. " is output. By then turning the steering wheel according to the voice guidance, the vehicle can be parallel parked in an appropriate position.

LIST1.TITLE: When Perpendicular Parking (Parking in a Garage)

ITEM.PTXT: The "parking guide line" indicates the steering angle when the steering wheel is turned fully while backing up; by backing up until the parking guide line aligns with the parking space line, the vehicle can be moved to an appropriate position before turning the steering wheel.

The "parking guide lines" serve as a guide for the position at which to stop when reversing straight back during parallel parking, etc.; by reversing until the parking guide lines match the desired parking position, such as the road shoulder or parking space lines, the vehicle can be moved to the appropriate position before turning the steering wheel.
A diagnosis function is provided to make system inspection easier. Diagnosis results are output as diagnostic codes using a service tool. For details, refer to the Repair Manual.
